title: Document Embedding
description: A document-level vector embedding associated with an Impresso content item.

ci_type.description: Type of the content item in the rebuilt representation.

embedding.description: Vector representation of the content item as a one-dimensional array of numbers.

items.description: One component of the document embedding vector.

size.description: Dimensionality of the embedding vector. This value must equal the number of values in `embedding`.

ts.description: Timestamp indicating when the embedding was generated (e.g., '2024-10-09T09:29:02Z').
